title: Prove which file a control connection's SQLite holds, so control_connection_read can answer
outcome: Prove which file a control connection's SQLite holds, so control_connection_read can answer
acceptance: On a platform where Engram can prove, from the handle SQLite itself holds, that the file at the reported canonical path is the store's main database, control_connection_read returns database_path, project_id and session_id; elsewhere it keeps refusing with control_connection_identity_unavailable

Tests swap, junction-redirect and restore the path around and after the open (including an ancestor turned into a junction) and the read never reports a path naming a file the connection does not hold
Any unsafe code is narrowly scoped and carries Greg's recorded approval
disposal_reason: Duplicate follow-up filed in parallel. w-952b4211be2d (Fable, 12:10Z) has the same handle-level design, full acceptance criteria and P0, and it is the reference TermAl received as R4's single dependency (Architect3 #229). This item's design notes and the explorer's two quoted Highs remain readable here as history.
